conflicts.permit: For example, we may share Personally Identifiable Information as follows: (i) with vendors, consultants, and other service providers (" Service Providers ") who are engaged by or working with us in connection with the operation of the Service and who need access to such information to carry out their work for us
conflicts.prohibit: (with the exception of Personally Identifiable Information, which shall not become publicly available, unless such Personally Identifiable Information is shared by you as part of a review, photo submission or other similar method).
conflicts.situation: Sharing a user's personally identifiable information with third-party service providers or other parties when the user has not shared it as part of a review or photo submission.
conflicts.reason: Section 4(b) contains a blanket prohibition stating PII shall not become publicly available unless submitted via review/photo, but 4(a) permits sharing PII with service providers without this restriction.
